Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs and .changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-ui.md (the rule and the gate that prices it, read as one), and on `origin/main`: `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (`applyDeclaredColumnDefault` docblock L8400–8462, `createColumn` L8390), `sql-driver-column-creation.ts` (`createColumn` L713 → `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` L1186), `sql-driver-rotation.ts` (existing-table ADD COLUMN L541–560), `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` (`buildActionSandboxContext`, `warnDiscardedRecordWrites`), `quickjs-runner.ts` (`installApiMethod`, the WRITE set, `throwCapabilityDenial`), `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (`action-record-write-discarded`, `action-no-placement`), `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (`VisualizationTypeSchema`, `GalleryConfigSchema.coverField`, `KanbanConfigSchema.groupByField`, `defineView` expansion L7866–7896), `ui/action.zod.ts` (`objectName`, `locations`, `type`, `target`, `refreshAfter`), `ui/app.zod.ts` (`viewName`), `data/hook-body.zod.ts` (L1 expression vs L2 js), `data/field.zod.ts` (`defaultValue` describe), `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx` + `ObjectKanban.tsx`, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/resolve-view-id.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`

Full review of the first substantive head of PR #31479, port 3/3 of card #31155 (the `objectstack-ui` domain), modelled on the #31393 records (6718050728, 6718283200). Inputs: the PR body, the file list, the three-dot diff against `origin/main` c65599fa (merge-base 708922f9; `main` has since moved five commits, none touching this PR's paths), `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main cc008cb1` (conflict-free, tree 719c3e2e), the merge commit 5c42c301 checked against `git merge-tree f3b29bf8 708922f9` (identical: nothing of its own), ledger note 4 6720427004, the dev report 6720444099, the v1 ledger 6711215678 with its corrections, and the check-runs on this head. Byte and line counts, the CJK scan and the eval checks are my own reads (`git show` piped to `wc`, Python over the file bytes), not the dev's. Claim on this head: 6720461008. ⛔ nothing was built, run or re-run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Scope holds.** Exactly the eight PR files in the three-dot diff (+160 / −44); four commits (f3b29bf8, merge 5c42c301, a5a51530, cc008cb1). GitHub reported `mergeable_state: unknown` at my first read (just pushed); the merge-tree is conflict-free. Draft kept.
2. **add-view-not-convert — TRUE against spec and runtime.** `view.zod.ts` L7866–7880: `defineView` expands every `listViews` key to `${object}.${key}` (`uniqueViewName`), so "registered as `OBJECT.status_kanban`" is exact; `resolve-view-id.ts` L39–46 resolves a nav item's `viewName` from the bare key by prefixing `object.` (and accepts the full name), so "the key a nav item's `viewName` names" is exact — the wording the last commit cc008cb1 corrected to. `VisualizationTypeSchema` (L1896) lets the default `list` carry `type: 'kanban'`, and nothing in the spec refuses retyping it, as the text says ("nothing refuses it"); the tool-side refusal stays CLOUD. Eval 13 pins it (`listViews` must_contain; `list: { type: 'kanban'` must_not_contain).
3. **19f — TRUE, with clause (c) ported CORRECTED, verified along the call path.** `sql-driver-rotation.ts` L553–560: on an existing table every declared field not in `existingColumns` goes through `this.createColumn` inside `knex.schema.alterTable` (the ADD COLUMN path); `sql-driver-column-creation.ts` `createColumn` (L713) ends in `this.applyDeclaredColumnDefault(col, field, type)` (L1186); the method's docblock (`sql-driver.ts` L8402–8431) emits case 4, "a real literal, verbatim", as the column DEFAULT, and emits nothing for case 2 (runtime tokens, resolved by the engine at insert), case 3 (expression envelopes, app-side) and an option-level `default: true` (#7246). Its own "runs for a FRESH column … never a retrofit of an existing table" sentence is about columns that already exist, not about a column being added, so it does not cut against the reading. A column DEFAULT on ADD COLUMN fills the pre-existing rows on every SQL dialect the driver serves, so those records carry the literal and land in its lane; the memory and mongodb drivers have no DDL half. `field.zod.ts` L1395 describes `defaultValue` as "applied on INSERT", which is what the text says of the token and CEL shapes. The lane: `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx` L185 pushes `KANBAN_UNCOLUMNED_ID` last with the `Uncategorized` title; `ObjectKanban.tsx` L1884–1891 writes the record's field on a drag OUT of it and refuses to persist a drop INTO it. So the three-part hand-over — (a) all in the last lane, scroll right, (b) drag out or edit from the list, (c) the per-datasource `defaultValue` truth — matches the runtime. The per-datasource split is stated in one sentence an agent can act on (token/CEL: no existing row changes; SQL + literal: existing rows read it), and the spec's describe is cited correctly for the INSERT half. The cloud sentence (c) is rightly left for card 4 (cloud#3714). Eval 13 pins the disclosure (`Uncategorized`, `groupByField: 'priority'`; never "ready to use").
4. **13 — TRUE against spec, sandbox and lint.** `action.zod.ts` L1193: `objectName` "auto-merged into the object's actions array by defineStack()" (= "folds it into that object's record surfaces"); L1199 `locations`; `record_header` is a member (L749); `refreshAfter` is a real key (L1619), so eval 14's reference answer is well-formed. `body-runner.ts` L41–44 and L1419–1420: `ctx.record` is "a read-only pre-fetched snapshot"; `buildActionSandboxContext` (L1387–1418) hands `recordId`; `warnDiscardedRecordWrites` (L807–819) says the writes "never left the sandbox" and prescribes `ctx.api.object(…).update({ id: ctx.recordId, … })` "(needs the 'api.write' capability)". `quickjs-runner.ts` L706–708: `insert` / `update` / `delete` / `updateMany` / `deleteMany` / `upsert` are the WRITE set installed under `api.write`, and L1337–1345 throws a capability denial naming the call when the cap is absent — "the sandbox throws … without it". `hook-body.zod.ts` L105–106: an expression body "is a pure formula: it performs no …" — the `js`-not-`expression` reason. `rule-explanations.ts` L1302–1307: `action-record-write-discarded` — "the handler returns the body's value and applies nothing to the record"; L5428–5436: `action-no-placement` — an action that omits `locations` and that no view places by name "parses … renders nothing", with `bulkActions` / `bulkActionDefs` named. Every clause of the new § Actions paragraph has its runtime sentence. Eval 14 pins it (`defineAction`, `ctx.api.object('task').update`, `ctx.recordId`, `api.write`, `status: 'done'`; never `defineView(`, `language: 'expression'`, `status: 'Done'`).
5. **auto-surfaced — TRUE against spec.** `VisualizationTypeSchema` enumerates `grid`, `kanban`, `gallery`, `gantt`, …; `GalleryConfigSchema.coverField` (L1805) is "Attachment/image field to display as card cover"; `KanbanConfigSchema.groupByField` (L1824) is required. Eval 15 pins it (`type: 'gallery'`, `coverField: 'main_image'`; never `type: 'grid'`). The tool-envelope half stays CLOUD.
6. **English-only (the #31223 ruling).** My scan over the CJK, kana, fullwidth and CJK-punctuation blocks: 0 code points at the head in `SKILL.md`, `rules/list-views.md`, `rules/navigation.md`, `rules/record-page.md`, `evals/README.md`, the changeset and every line the PR adds to the ratchet script. On `main` the two carriers hold 13 code points (`navigation.md` L78–79) and 4 (`record-page.md` L13–14); the dispatch's "13 lines / 4 lines" were code-point counts, as the PR body notes. The replacements are faithful: "a simplified screen for the business team" / "workbench" for the two interface-page signals; `Activity` for the record page's second tab is the console's own label (`RecordPageColumns.tsx` L332/L363, `t('detail.timeline', { defaultValue: 'Activity' })`). Eval prompts keep their language under exemption (a); `objectstack-i18n` untouched (b).
7. **Eval file.** Parses; 15 cases, ids 1–15 contiguous and unique, one key shape. Cases 13–15: no `must_not_contain` string appears in its own `expected_output`, every `must_contain` string does. 13 tests add-view-not-convert + 19f, 14 tests 13, 15 tests auto-surfaced — each the rule it maps to. `evals/README.md` names the three new scenarios in the file's line.
8. **Ratchet rows, recomputed on the head and on the merge result against current `main` (identical bytes: `main` did not move these files).** `SKILL.md`: 15276 bytes, stamp `  version: "18.3.0"` 20 bytes, priced 15256 → ceil(15256/4) = 3814 = the row (base 14151 − 20 = 14131, as the comment says). `rules/list-views.md`: 13802 → 3451 = the row (base 12503). `rules/navigation.md`: 8734 → 2184 = the row, LOWERED from 2196 (base 8779). `rules/record-page.md`: 3961 → 991 = the row, LOWERED from 996 (base 3982). All four pinned AT the measurement, headroom 0. CI agrees: `Type Check · source gates` (job 128704869768) prints the four rows at their ceilings and `lane-verdict: typecheck-source-gates: OK -- 33 gate(s): 33 passed, 0 red`. Authority as stated (cloud#3659 A, 6682024726; record 6513306068, quoted verbatim in the PR body).
9. **Every same-file pay-down is a genuine duplicate; nothing lost.** `SKILL.md`: the intro paragraph restates the frontmatter `description` (L3–6: Views, Dashboards, Reports, Actions); "Load objectstack-formula…" restates frontmatter L16; Common Pitfalls 1–2 fold into one item that keeps the 6–8 columns / `hidden` / `link: true` content and points at `rules/list-views.md` § Column Features (anchor present, rows `hidden` L78, `link` L82); the Record pages row's `slotted` / `full` clause restates Detailed Rules L131; "This blueprint is the default for …" restates the section's own "canonical UI assembly reference" line; the App-navigation row's "capability-aware visibility" gloss is `rules/navigation.md` L44–46 (`requiresObject` auto-hides). `rules/list-views.md`: the two Data Source comments are the blockquote under them; "footer aggregation" is the `summary` row (L83); "Need named presets? Add a `listViews` entry" is the bullet before (L140–141); "the saved-views switcher already covers presets" is the same bullet's L144; "the runtime refuses the request" is the ⛔ section's L194 ("ingress gate refuses any entry outside the allowed set"); the `searchableFields: []` comment is the table row L201; `// required on every list view` is the sentence above the example ("the top-level `columns` stays required"). `rules/navigation.md`: the removed "(objectui ADR-0055 …)" citation is the section heading L55; `rules/record-page.md`: "(one page at two widths)" is step 1's "Layout follows the width of the surface". The new `#adding-a-board-calendar-gallery-or-gantt-beside-the-list` anchor SKILL.md links to exists (L279).
10. **Ledger completeness.** The v1 ledger's PORT rows are: data — 15, 16, 16b, 17, 18, 19, 19d, 21, select-options, process-modeling (#31223, PASS 6715209241, merged); automation — 14, 14b, 14c (#31393, PASS 6718283200, merged); ui — auto-surfaced, add-view-not-convert, 13, 19f (this PR). The only other rows that name `objectstack-ui` (2, dashboards-second-beat) are SPEC / STATED / CLOUD and owe no prose; ledger note 4's reclassification of E/R row 8 to STATED checks against `rules/dashboards.md` L104–105 (`INVALID_FIELD` for `groupBy`, `DATASET_INVALID` at compile). No PORT row is left un-ported; what remains is CLOUD, SPEC/STATED and the routed E/R rows (#31224 and note 3's two halves). The card's port half is done with this PR.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-ui.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, line-initial `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching PR body L3–4. Docs and eval fixtures only; no `packages/spec` export, schema or accept-set change. `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` green on the head. Patch is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note owed. `open_questions: []`.
- Dev deviation (19f (c) ported corrected, not dropped): **answered — right.** The cloud sentence contradicts the runtime, not the spec; the ported sentence contradicts neither (the spec's "applied on INSERT" is what it says of tokens and CEL), and the datasource split is the honest statement an agent needs to make the hand-over true on SQL. Same ruling as 14c on #31393.
- Dev deviation (rule 13's `action_missing_object_binding` has no lint here, by contract): confirmed — `objectName` is `.optional()` on `ActionSchema` (L1193); the text names the two lints that do exist and the run-time denial for the third.
- Dev note on the dispatch's CJK line counts (13 / 4 were code points): confirmed by my scan of `main`.
- **Check-runs on cc008cb1, read 2026-11-08T10:46Z: 41 runs — 27 `success`, 13 path-filtered `skipped`, 0 `failure`, 1 `in_progress` (`Test Core (1/8)`).** `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and the other seven `Test Core` shards are green. This record does not claim "all green" while one shard runs; the landing pre-check re-reads them whole.
- Tier H: draft kept; landing waits for an APPROVED review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`; no seat arms, queues or readies it. Nothing to disarm.
- For the seat, not this PR's: the catalog's remaining CJK carriers (`objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`, `objectui/guides/i18n.md`); the per-datasource `defaultValue` observation the dev recorded (SQL fills existing rows through DDL, memory/mongo do not, and the spec's describe names only the INSERT half) — read from source, no probe, an observation for a card if the seat wants the describe to say it.

### ④ Design judgment

- `rules/list-views.md` § Adding a board … (L279–304): holds against `defineView`'s expansion, `resolveViewId`, the driver's ADD COLUMN path and the kanban renderer; the hand-over text makes the correct runtime behaviour the thing the agent tells the user, and the one corrected clause is scoped to "on a SQL datasource a LITERAL `defaultValue`", so an agent on memory/mongo is not misled either way. No must-fix.
- `SKILL.md` § View Types (L46–52) and § Actions (L237–252): hold against `VisualizationTypeSchema`, `GalleryConfigSchema`, `ActionSchema`, the sandbox and the two lints; the shape given writes, the two reasons (`js`, `api.write`) are the runtime's own, and `value`-not-label is consistent with #31393's rule 14. No must-fix.
- `rules/navigation.md`, `rules/record-page.md`: English replacements carry the same signals and the console's own tab label; the two cut parentheticals are stated at the heading and in step 1. No must-fix.
- `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` 13–15 and `evals/README.md`: each case tests its rule with a well-formed reference answer, no self-contradiction. No must-fix.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: two rows raised AT the measurement after genuine same-file deletions, two lowered to the measurement; all four hold on the landing tree against current `main`. No must-fix.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 cloud 私有 AI 编写规则里「界面」这一块移植进对外发布的 `@objectstack/skills`(`objectstack-ui`):① 「加一个看板 / 日历 / 画廊 / 甘特视图」是**新增**一个列表视图,不要把默认列表改掉;② 对一条记录的操作是 action 元数据,不是视图;写入按钮必须在 `js` 体里调 `ctx.api.object(…).update` 并声明 `api.write`——`ctx.record` 只读,返回值不会写回;③ 用户点名的视图类型照原样建,不要降级成表格;④ 按同一次新加的字段分组的看板,已有记录都会落在最后的「未分类」列,并说明怎么处理。新增 3 个评测用例,净增 65 行。
- **一处与私有原文不同**:原文说给新加的分组字段设默认值「不影响已有记录」;复审员沿调用链确认:在 SQL 数据源上,字面量默认值会成为新列的 DDL 默认值,已有记录会读到它(内存 / Mongo 数据源不会)。移植的是更正后的说法。
- **全英文**:按「skills 对外发布的版本应该全部用英文」,`navigation.md` 和 `record-page.md` 原有的中文也改成英文,两行体积上限反而降低。
- **这是 #31155 的最后一个移植 PR**:复审员核对了完整台账,除「留在 cloud」、spec 已表达、已转 spec 车道强制的条目外,没有剩余未移植的规则。合并后第 1 步的移植全部完成。
- **需要你做的**:审批合并(受管面 `skills/**`,Tier H)。契约复审 PASS 评论 `6720539234`,`Head-sha: cc008cb1b053e553947c8d28dedd7d1a60525b17`。
- **席位意见**:建议合并。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** `Part of #31155`, 8 files, governed `skills/**` ⇒ Tier H: draft kept, `pm:awaiting-merge` and review requested from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` in this pass; the seat neither approves, arms nor merges.
- **Contract review:** `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS `6720539234` on this head (claim `6720461008`): the four ledger rows verified along each call path; 19f(c) corrected; ledger completeness checked against v1 and its corrections; 15 same-file deletions each restated at the head.
- **门禁 check-runs on this head:** 42 check-runs completed — 29 success, 13 path-filtered skipped, 0 failed (incl. `Test Core` 1–8/8 and `Type Check · source gates` with the four ratchet rows at their ceilings).

Authority cloud#3659 A `6682024726` + record `6513306068`.
- **Out of scope, noted:** the spec's `defaultValue` describe names only the INSERT half (SQL's ADD COLUMN DEFAULT also fills existing rows; memory/mongo do not) — an observation, not filed; three catalog files still carry CJK (`objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`, `objectui/guides/i18n.md`) — a catalog-wide English card if the approver wants it; cloud's corpus still carries the uncorrected 19f(c) and 14c sentences → card 4 cloud#3714.
